title: Billboards
summary: A craftable billboard that shows pictures from web links: hang it on a wall or stand it on posts, pick its size and look, and set a slideshow.

s.x: is a big 16:9 screen in a real cabinet. It shows pictures from web links and cycles through up to four of them as a slideshow. Use one for event posters at spawn, a shop sign or a picture for your base.
It is also in the creative Functional Blocks tab.
right-click the side of a block. The billboard hangs on that wall, its bottom level with the block you clicked and centred on it.
right-click the top of a block. It stands on two posts there, two blocks off the ground, facing you.
It needs room: if something is in the way, you get a message and nothing is placed. The editor opens as soon as it's up.
Right-click the billboard to open the editor (only the player who placed it, or an op, can):
paste up to four links to PNG or JPG pictures (
3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16 blocks wide. The height is always 9/16 of the width, and pictures are cropped to fill the screen.
Blackstone, Dark Oak, Quartz, Copper or Iron, which changes the frame, back, truss and post textures and the trim.
. Everyone nearby sees the change straight away. If a bigger size doesn't fit where it is, it stays the old size.

The screen sits in a cabinet with a frame, a gold, copper or iron trim and a planked back with a log truss. Redstone-lamp bulbs chase round the top and bottom bars, and two sea-lantern spotlights on arms light the picture. A free-standing one has posts with a brace. The picture and the lit bulbs glow; the rest takes the world's light like any block. The billboard also lights the ground in front of it.
Hit it. The owner (or an op) breaks it and gets the Billboard back, settings and all reset; place it again somewhere else. Other players can't break or change your billboard.
